title: No Credits
description: Removes (most of) the long credits that some people don't want to see.
body:
![No Credits Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fff92f1f8a930c3fe486bffc71f91cbde9779d41.png)
No Credits is a Resource Pack that gets rid of the vast majority of the credits, leaving only the Minecraft logo in it's place.
Before and After:
‎
![Before vs After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad2e1e7045c07479caf815f3a0cdc773f439a99f.png) Before, you either had to wait a long while for all of the credits to roll, or you could just press escape. But now, you can just see the words "Minecraft Java Edition" go past your screen, and you are back in the game.
![The No Credits FAQ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e71e00b55c8ad3acbf95791488bf194a9318eb93.png) Here are some Frequently Asked Questions that I ask myself.
Frequently Asked Questions **Why did you make this?** > For fun. **Are you going make this avalible on earlier versions?** > Maybe... we'll see. I might just add support for 1.8.x, 1.12.x, and probably 1.16.x since I already have 1.20.2-1.21.10 **Why is the word "Player" in the logo off center and randomly capitalized?** > I noticed it after I already rendered it, and I was too lazy to change it. I'll probably change it sometime in the future, just not right now.

### 📄 Other Projects - [](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/no-microsoft-splashes) [No Microsoft Splashes](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/no-microsoft-splashes) - Removes all of the Minecraft Splashes and Credits after the acquisition of Mojang and returns the ones that had left. (Reverts to 1.8.8) - [](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/no-credits) [Old Credits](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/old-credits) - Reverts the credits to how they were in release 1.8.8, before Microsoft bought Minecraft. - More coming soon
